The service must have two or three OrchestrationService dependencies.

What The Standard says

“Two-Three” — The Standard limits orchestration-like services to two or three service dependencies to control complexity and preserve architectural balance. read it here.
“Variants Levels” — The variants table defines a Coordination service as an orchestration variant whose dependencies are Orchestration services. Together these passages require two or three orchestration dependencies. read it here.

Why it matters

Coordination services join a small number of orchestration flows without becoming an unlimited dependency hub. The two-to-three dependency boundary preserves a comprehensible scope and signals when another architectural decomposition is needed.

Bad code example

// Violates STXC001: The service must have two or three OrchestrationService dependencies.
class StudentCoordinationService(IStudentProcessingService students) : IStudentCoordinationService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXC001
class StudentCoordinationService(
    IStudentOrchestrationService students,
    ISchoolOrchestrationService schools) : IStudentCoordinationService { }
